sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant no. 2 is husband of opposite party no. 2 and applicant nos. 1 and 3 are mother in law and father in law of the opposite party no. 2.

It is further submitted that on 18.07.2022 when the applicant nos. 2 and 3 had gone to meet their advocates J.P. Singh Baghel at his office situated in the civil court compound Aligarh, to prepare the written statement in the various litigation initiated by the opposite party no. 2 pending in the court of judgeship Aligarh.
On 18.07.2022 while they were returning by a four wheeler having registration no. U.P. 82 R-3762 the opposite party reached their armed with lathi and dandas and abused and committed marpeet.
It is further submitted that the applicants have sustained serious injuries.

Learned counsel for opposite party nos. 2 to 4 opposed the prayer of the applicants and submitted that there is no time, no medical examination and no FIR has been lodged with regard to the incident as alleged.
It is further submitted that other cases related to 125 Cr.P.C. of domestic violence are also pending in the competent court of judgeship Aligarh.
In view of the above facts and circumstances the present case has no merit and it deserves to be dismissed.
